notes: Files created (for the driver to commit): src/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/67-resumed-sixth-after-epiphany/research/context.md (inventory and source plan) and src/claude/liturgy/roman-rite/1962/propers/temporal/67-resumed-sixth-after-epiphany/main.tex (scaffold comment only). Shared-record observations, recorded in context.md for their owners: (1) the resumed printing's Epistle citation '1 Thess. 1, 1-20' (p. 421, PDF 502) is a misprint for 1, 2-10 and no inventory or collation notes it; (2) the finding aid resolves the Collect and Postcommunion through epiphany-6 with the Epiphany-season conclusions, while the resumed printing (nos. 1760, 1768) prints 'Per Dominum.'; (3) no ledger row or collation covers resumed nos. 1759-1768, the pentecost-23 chants, or the epiphany-6 Epistle and Gospel.
summary: Resolved Sunday 15 November 2026 to identity 67, Dominica VI quae superfuit post Epiphaniam, II classis (Missale Romanum 1962, pp. 421-422, nos. 1759-1768, PDF 502-503, read at 200/400 dpi on the registered CMAA facsimile fetched to its registered hash), as RG 18 b slot 25 of 26 Sundays after Pentecost; St Albert the Great (III classis) is impeded and not commemorated (RG 111 b), Trinity Preface, green, Gloria and Credo, no branch; computation, printed rubrics and calendar, and two dated Ordos (FSSP France, ICRSP France) agree. Not reference-only. research/context.md records the complete ten-element inventory with loci, the resumed-versus-Epiphany-season printing differences (including the resumed Epistle's misprinted citation '1 Thess. 1, 1-20' for 1:2-10 and the short oration conclusions), wording against the Clementine, the Ordinary's appointed parts, lawful Latin and English routes, and the remaining verification plan; main.tex holds only the reserved-owner scaffold comment.
